family_reports.body: The system has wrecked my family. If my older children want to speak to their seven year-old brother, they have to deal with the man who abused us. I’ve lost eight months with my son. He was forced into public school. We don’t do public schools. My son is living with an abuser someone who’s tried to kill himself multiple times and someone who has tried to kill me multiple times. I’ve been harassed by law-enforcement in court officials. I had to move thousands of miles away for safety from the system. I’m not even allowed to speak to my son. My son sent me a Snapchat video where he was telling me. He loves me. He misses me. He really wants to see me. Hurry up and get my stuff done so I can see him. The court refuses to give me my final judgment since January 9 and I don’t even know what my legal last name is. There’s no way for me to know what stipulations to court have in order to see my son. I feel like my life is pointless until I can get my child away from that man. I’ve been labeled as mentally unstable for simply being a victim of domestic violence.
Lied and destroyed my family along with trying to brainwash my children.
Completely destroyed us by tearing us apart without hearing our evidence and placing my children in the hands of a pedophile
